before.description: 4 tiles: teleports you to the aimed tile, up to 4 tiles away

before.name: Counterspell
before.description: Real reaction to Fireball; fixture seed 7.

before.name: Dispel Magic
before.description: 6 tiles: ends concentration; ends magical conditions on target

before.name: Fireball
before.description: Dex save, 6 tiles, burst 2: 6d6 fire; half damage on a save — Game balance: 6d6 per target instead of SRD 8d6.

before.name: Haste
before.description: 4 tiles: target is Hasted for 10 rounds

before.name: Hypnotic Pattern
before.description: Wis save, 6 tiles, burst 2: target is Incapacitated until saved — A twisting pattern of colours leaves those who see it charmed and dazed.

before.name: Lightning Bolt
before.description: Dex save, self, line 10: 6d6 lightning; half damage on a save — Game balance: 6d6 per target, matching Fireball.

before.name: Slow
before.description: Wis save, 6 tiles, burst 2: target is Slowed until saved

before.name: Banishment
before.description: Cha save, 6 tiles: target is Incapacitated until saved — The target is cast into a harmless elsewhere, out of the fight until it fights its way back.

before.name: Blight
before.description: Con save, 4 tiles: 8d8 necrotic; half damage on a save

before.name: Greater Invisibility
before.description: 1 tile: target is Invisible for 10 rounds

before.name: Ice Storm
before.description: 6 tiles, burst 2: creates a ice zone (burst 2) for 1 round, difficult terrain; Dex save (2d8 bludgeoning; 4d6 cold; half damage on a save)

before.name: Wall of Fire
before.description: 6 tiles, ring 2: creates a fire zone (ring 2) for 10 rounds, ends if you lose concentration; units inside: At the start of your turn, on yourself: Dex save (1d8 fire; half damage on a save); Dex save (5d8 fire; half damage on a save) — Game balance: the initial hit deals 5d8; ongoing damage is 1d8 per turn instead of SRD 5d8.

before.name: Cloudkill
before.description: 6 tiles, burst 2: creates a poison zone (burst 2) for 10 rounds, ends if you lose concentration; units inside: At the start of your turn, on yourself: Con save (5d8 poison; half damage on a save); Con save (6d8 poison; half damage on a save) — Game balance: the initial hit deals 6d8 poison; ongoing damage is the SRD 5d8.

before.name: Cone of Cold
before.description: Con save, self, cone 7: 8d8 cold; half damage on a save

before.name: Hold Monster
before.description: Wis save, 6 tiles: target is Paralysed until saved

before.name: Time Shift
before.description: Chronomancer: 6 tiles: swaps target's place with the unit 1 place after it in the turn order

before.name: Accelerate
before.description: Chronomancer: 6 tiles: moves target 2 places earlier in the turn order; target gets +1 AC and +1 Move for 2 rounds

before.name: Temporal Stasis
before.description: Chronomancer: Wis save, 6 tiles: 4d8 force; delays target by 3 places in the turn order; target is Slowed for 2 rounds; half damage on a save

before.name: Sculpted Nova
before.description: Evoker: Dex save, 6 tiles, burst 2: 2d6 fire; half damage on a save — You shape the blast around your allies: it strikes only foes.

before.name: Empowered Evocation
before.description: Visible passive triggered during Fire Bolt. Spell attack, 6 tiles: 2d10 fire

before.name: Sculpted Inferno
before.description: Evoker: Dex save, 6 tiles, burst 3: 8d6 fire; half damage on a save — Once per battle you pour everything into one sculpted storm of fire that spares your allies.

before.name: Raise Earth
before.description: Geomancer: 6 tiles: raises the terrain (single tile) by 2

before.name: Sink Earth
before.description: Geomancer: 6 tiles: sinks the terrain (single tile) by 2

before.name: Tremor
before.description: Geomancer: Dex save, 6 tiles, burst 1: 3d8 bludgeoning; target is Prone; half damage on a save

before.name: Stone Spire
before.description: Geomancer: 6 tiles, burst 1: raises the terrain (burst 1) by 2; Dex save (6d8 bludgeoning; target is Prone; half damage on a save)
